targets.authors: Sirieix, L., Remaud, H., Lockshin, L., Thach, L. & Lease, T.
targets.title: Determinants of restaurant owner/managers selection of wines to be offered on the wine list
targets.evidence_quote: Because of the limited research activities related to the use of wine lists for the selection of wines in restaurant settings, as indicated above, the objective of this research is to replicate the work of Sirieix et al. ( 2011 ) in a South African context.
targets.outcome_quote: When the results of this study are compared with the aggregate results of the Sirieix et al. study ( 2011 ), three of the factors of the most preferred strategy that emerged in this study are similar to those outlined by Sirieix et al. These three factors are indicated in Table 7 , with a correction mark (‘✓’) next to the reason. However, two of the factors from the least preferred strategy of this study were part of the most preferred strategy of Sirieix et al.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly compare agreeing and reversed strategy factors, and conclude similarities and differences. Abstract agreement on two leading factors is not a whole-replication verdict overriding those contrasts.
